about_short_description.short_description: Iron Fish is a novel cryptocurrency focused on privacy and accessibility.

product.name: Iron Fish Node App
product.description: A desktop application that allows users to run their own Iron Fish node, send, receive, and bridge assets securely.

product.name: OreoWallet
product.description: A browser-based wallet extension for making secure and private Iron Fish transactions directly from the browser.

product.name: Iron Fish Bi-Directional Bridge
product.description: A bridging service that enables encrypted transfer of assets between Iron Fish and over 20 EVM-compatible blockchains.

product.name: Iron Fish CLI (Command Line Interface)
product.description: A command-line tool for managing Iron Fish accounts, transactions, nodes, and mining operations.

product.name: Iron Fish WASM Package
product.description: A WebAssembly package that compiles Iron Fish cryptographic code for use in JavaScript environments like browsers and extensions.

product.name: Iron Fish Block Explorer
product.description: A web-based tool to view and track Iron Fish blockchain transactions and blocks with limited public information due to privacy features.
